scope: protocol-side accrued rewards for Personal Onchain Companies and Defitea Fund

methodology.definition: Rewards already earned inside protocol contracts but not yet freely held in the company/fund wallet.
methodology.multiWallet: Defitea rewards are measured independently for defitea.eth and the Defitea Operations wallet, then aggregated into one Defitea Passport. Every reward retains wallet provenance.
methodology.aerodromeVelodrome: Aerodrome and Velodrome direct veNFT routes reconstruct every historically voted pool from indexed Voter.Voted events, using provider-aware direct RPC eth_getLogs and Blockscout fallback reads. A validated full-history cache makes later runs incremental with a reorg-safe overlap. Each discovered pool’s current voting-reward contracts are queried for still-unclaimed rewards. Managed/Relay rewards are read directly. Defitea Velodrome additionally discovers veNFT ownership through official 40 Acres Optimism portfolio factories. Already distributed 40 Acres wallet payouts are not counted as accrued rewards.
methodology.curve: Base crvUSD FeeDistributor claims are simulated. VoteMarket veCRV uses official Stake DAO proof membership, published raw vote details, VoteMarket claimed-state and period state to reproduce the Votemarket claim formula; OracleLens is used as an onchain cross-check when populated. LaPoste pToken rewards are mapped onchain through TokenFactory.nativeTokens and valued 1:1 at the native L1 token price.
methodology.convex: Votium/The Union remains intentionally excluded until a reproducible member-level reward read is validated.
methodology.pendle: Per-wallet sPENDLE claimable merkle rewards and accrued ETH fees are read from Pendle official Core API. Legacy vePENDLE is normalized from vePendlePositionData for Passport display without adding it to TVL.
methodology.fx: Base veFXN FeeDistributor claims are simulated. VoteMarket veFXN uses official Stake DAO proof membership, published raw vote details, VoteMarket claimed-state and period state to reproduce the Votemarket claim formula; OracleLens is used as an onchain cross-check when populated. LaPoste pToken rewards are mapped onchain through TokenFactory.nativeTokens and valued 1:1 at the native L1 token price.
methodology.yieldBasis: FeeDistributor.preview_claim is used; yb rewards are valued at current redemption value into underlying BTC assets.
methodology.frax: Fraxtal YieldDistributor.earned(account), with emitted reward token discovered onchain.
methodology.liquity: LQTYStaking pending ETH and LUSD gains.
methodology.resupply: GovStaker reward tokens are dynamically enumerated and earned(account, token) is read onchain. reUSD is valued with an explicit 1:1 USD parity assumption.
methodology.tvlTreatment: Accrued Rewards remain separate from Company TVL and Treasury cash.
